game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Whispering Corridor, a whispering corridor: the lantern keeper must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Break Out: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted.
theme: Shadow Cave – Whispering Corridor: a whispering corridor
core_gameplay_loop: In Whispering Corridor, repeat each round: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted. Each round, giant bats strike the mine cart, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the alert value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the mine cart from giant bats in Whispering Corridor: keep the alert meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: alert drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 38-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Break Out
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Break Out' (Week 4 slot 10), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Whispering Corridor'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how alert changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Whispering Corridor.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 38 seconds while alert > 0.
